name: StatCite
description:
StatCite returns official economic statistics — World Bank WDI, IMF WEO/Fiscal Monitor (current vintage via the IMF's own DataMapper API), and ECB reference rates — where every number ships with a full citation: source, dataset, series ID, canonical URL, license, retrieval date, and a ready-to-paste citation sentence.

Its verify_stat tool checks any claimed economic figure against the official series and returns a verdict (match / close / mismatch / cannot_verify) with diagnostics for the classic errors: wrong year, percent-vs-decimal slips, and millions/billions scale confusion. verify_claims batch-checks up to 15 claims from a draft in one call.

An as_of parameter enables revision-aware verification: check whether a claim was true against the IMF WEO/Fiscal Monitor edition that was current on a given historical date, not just today's revised figure.

42 curated indicators across 200+ economies, inflation adjustment, and historical FX conversion (including ~90 currencies the ECB set doesn't cover). Free, read-only, no authentication required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add StatCite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add StatCite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://statcite.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is StatCite MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, StatCite scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the StatCite MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: StatCite provides these MCP tools: country_snapshot, fetch, fx_convert, get_indicator, get_series, inflation_adjust, list_sources, search, search_indicators, verify_claims, and verify_stat.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to StatCite?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to StatCite in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and ClickHouse Cloud MCP Server.
StatCite does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
StatCite is developed by StatCite. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
